evals.prompt: Build me a Telegram bot in Python for splitting restaurant bills. A user types an amount and how many people, picks a tip with buttons (0, 10, 15, 20%), and gets per-person cost. It should work in private chats and groups. I don't have a token handy, so just make it ready to run, and include tests.

We run a Telegram bot that sends daily Spanish vocabulary quizzes. Users can take today's quiz, see their streak, change reminder time, and upgrade to Pro. Design the /start experience: exact message text, keyboard layout, what returning users see vs brand new users, what happens with a referral deep link. Put the result in START_DESIGN.md, plus screens.json with the actual Bot API message payloads (text, parse_mode, reply_markup) for each screen.

bot.py is our course-school support bot. The messages look awful and users say it feels like spam. Redesign all the texts and buttons so it looks professional. Don't change what the bot does or any of the facts/prices/policies. Edit bot.py in place.

bot.py is a task manager bot. The navigation is bad: 37 tasks appear as a giant list, each tap creates a new message, there's no way back, and the Yes/No buttons confuse people so they delete tasks by accident. Please fix the inline keyboard navigation and add tests. Tasks belong to the owner in OWNER, so other users shouldn't be able to touch them.

Build a Telegram bot in Python where people send an audio or video file and get back a voice message (OGG Opus). It'll run on a small 2-core VPS and might get a few hundred users. FFmpeg is installed. Show progress, handle bad and oversized files gracefully, and include tests. No token yet.

Build a Telegram bot in Python that sells a monthly premium subscription giving access to premium daily tips. Handle purchase, renewals, cancellation, expiry, and a way for users to get a refund or help. Use whatever payment approach is right for Telegram. Include tests. No token yet.

Build a secure Telegram bot marketplace for digital products (PDF guides and license keys). Sellers are approved by an admin, buyers browse and pay, and they get the product instantly. Keep it in Python and make sure nobody can get something without paying or get charged twice for one delivery. Include tests. No token yet.

Create a Telegram Mini App for a small coffee shop: browse the menu, customise a drink, place a pickup order. Frontend in plain HTML/CSS/JS or a light framework, backend in Python. Make it look like a real product and make sure orders are tied to the real Telegram user. Include a way to preview it in a browser, and backend tests. No token yet.

bot.py is our shop bot and users are complaining: some buttons spin forever, Купить doesn't work for some products, the catalog refresh logs errors, and one product screen crashes. Find and fix the bugs and add regression tests. Keep the existing behaviour otherwise.

bot.py has grown messy. Refactor it into a clean maintainable structure so we can keep adding features. Do not change any business logic or anything users see. Include whatever gives us confidence nothing changed.
